battle.name: 伊斯蘭教二次內戰
battle.theater: 敘利亞南部至約旦東北部
battle.brief: 680年哈里發穆阿維葉一世即遇挑戰，伊本·阿什阿特率遜尼系聯軍自埃及進逼敘利亞；682年艾因瓦爾達之役叛軍得手，683至684年間麥加遭焚，692年馬爾季阿爾達比勒一役平叛。羅馬投石機不在阿拉伯軍中，其扭力存能之法是拜占庭手拉式投石機與阿拉伯攻城器的源頭。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 第二次內戰（又稱第二場菲特奈）爆發於680年，交戰的兩方是倭馬亞哈里發國的中央軍，以及以伊本·阿什阿特為首的部落聯軍。中央一方以大馬士革為都，由哈里發穆阿維葉一世總攬，其兵源是所謂「軍人之家」阿沙斯：哈里發的族親、與先知家族結姻的部落酋長，還有一批出身奴隸卻以軍功取得自由的馬瓦利將領，被授予敘利亞與伊拉克的邊郡；穆阿維葉刻意讓自己的兒子接替易位，並倚重也門系的卡爾比與亞曼尼部落，把哈里發之位做成可以授予、也可以收回的官銜。聯軍一方以遜尼系聯盟為骨幹，包含加茲、蘇拉瑪、馬茲等北方部落，也吸納了哈希姆家的阿卜杜拉·本·哈桑，以及部分卡爾比系的達哈克·本·阿卜杜拉，號稱維護先知血統，並以埃及為基地，靠尼羅河的稅收與徵發供養軍隊。聯軍的指揮系統是典型的部落聯盟：各酋長自領一軍，沒有統一參謀，戰時靠「阿米爾」式的臨時盟約協同，因此中央一破便難以重整。第三方是拜占庭帝國，它在第一次內戰中已用金錢與武器資助阿拉伯的反對派，此次也向聯軍提供援助；產油區的迦太基與北非據點則在哈里發方手中。整體看，這是一場以部落忠誠為經、哈里發繼承程序為緯的內戰。
countriesEn: The Second Fitna, the second civil war of the caliphate, broke out in 680, with the central army of the Umayyad Caliphate on one side and a tribal confederation led by Ishaq ibn al-Ash'ath on the other. The central side had its capital at Damascus and was commanded by the caliph Muawi I, who drew his troops from the ashraf, the house of the warriors: kinsmen of the caliph, tribal chiefs who had married into the family of the Prophet, and a body of mawla, freedmen of servile birth who had earned their place by long service, who were given the frontier districts of Syria and Iraq. Muawi deliberately made the caliphate a dignity his own sons could be given, and he relied on the Kalbi and Yamani tribes of the south, turning the office into something that could be assigned and withdrawn. The confederation was built on the Qaysi tribal alliance, including northern clans such as the Ghamid, the Sulaymi and the Maz, and it drew in Abdullah ibn al-Hassan of the house of Hashim and part of the Kalbi under al-Dahhak ibn Abd Allah, claiming the tradition of the blood of the Prophet, and it based itself in Egypt, drawing its grain and its money from the taxation of the Nile. Its command structure was that of a typical tribal coalition: each chief led his own contingent, there was no unified staff, and the confederates were held together only by temporary amir-style covenants during a campaign, so that once the centre was pierced the whole could not be re-formed. A third party was the Byzantine Empire, which had already supplied money and weapons to Arab opponents in the First Fitna and did so again to the confederation; the oil revenues of Carthage and the North African bases stood on the caliph's side. Seen as a whole, this was a civil war in which tribal loyalty formed the warp and the procedure of succession to the caliphate the weft.
people: 穆阿維葉一世是全場的勝負手。他不像前任那樣靠血統正統取得共識，而是把哈里發之位變成可以指定、可以轉移的權柄：先立雅齊德二世，隨即換穆阿維葉二世，再換雅齊德三世，最後落足於馬爾萬一世。麥加出身的伊本·阿什阿特是遜尼系的領袖，他父親阿爾·阿什阿特當年奉雅齊德一世之命自埃及押解俘虜西行，沿途受盡凌辱，這份羞辱記在穆阿維葉一方帳上；伊本·阿什阿特自幼以此為念，拒絕向新哈里發效忠。682年的艾因瓦爾達之役，聯軍主帥是卡爾比系的達哈克·本·阿卜杜拉，他擊潰了馬爾萬與馬斯拉馬指揮的哈里發軍；同一役中陣亡的阿茲迪部名將哈里斯·本·阿卜杜拉，其復讎之作就是683至684年焚燒麥加的一役，由哈里發之子阿卜杜拉·本·阿米爾與也門人優素福·本·烏拜爾·阿爾·胡瑪伊迪指揮。聯軍另一根柱子是哈希姆家的阿卜杜拉·本·哈桑，他以宗室身分號召，把第一次內戰中阿里一系的正統旗號重新舉起。拜占庭方面，皇帝與官員只在幕後提供金錢、武器與工程師；阿拉伯方面的樞紐人物還有687年前後在庫法起兵的穆赫塔爾·本·阿比·烏拜德，他以阿里之子哈希姆的名義起兵，使哈里發方在伊拉克分兵，牽制了正面。
peopleEn: Muawi I was the man who decided the outcome. Unlike his predecessors he did not rest on a shared belief in legitimate blood, but turned the caliphate into an authority that could be designated and transferred: first Yazid II, then Muawi II, then Yazid III, and finally Marwan I. Ishaq ibn al-Ash'ath, who came from Mecca, was the leader of the Qaysi. His father al-Ash'ath had once been ordered by Yazid I to march from Egypt with a column of prisoners, and the humiliation of that march was charged to the account of Muawi's house; the son grew up with the grievance and refused to acknowledge the new caliph. At the battle of Ayn al-Warda in 682 the confederation was commanded by the Kalbi al-Dahhak ibn Abd Allah, who broke the caliph's army led by Marwan and Maslama; the Azdi commander al-Harith ibn Abd Allah fell in that same fight, and his revenge was the siege and burning of Mecca in 683 and 684, a campaign directed by the caliph's son Abd Allah ibn Amir together with the Yemeni Yusuf ibn Ubayr al-Humaydi. Another pillar of the confederation was Abd Allah ibn al-Hassan of the house of Hashim, who used his place in the Prophet's family to raise once more the banner of legitimacy that the party of Ali had carried in the First Fitna. On the Byzantine side emperors and officials acted only from behind the curtain, supplying money, weapons and engineers. On the Arab side one more pivot was al-Mukhtar ibn Abi Ubayd al-Thaqafi, who rose in Kufa around 687 in the name of Hashim, the son of Ali; the rising forced the caliph to split his forces in Iraq and so tied down the front.
kits: 卡面上的投石機（onager）是羅馬人的攻城利器，約公元前250年前後定型，維特魯威斯在《建築十書》卷十記載了它的做法：木製機架橫樑上裝鐵軸，軸的兩端以扭力束（繩或馬毛，浸水後反向纏緊）儲存彈力，一根長臂一端扣在扭力束上，另一端裝皮兜或彈兜，用絞盤把臂拉下再放開，把石彈甩出去。拉丁語「onager」以驢踢作比，晚期古代的軍事文獻，如四世紀的韋格蒂烏斯，已用這名稱指代這類單臂扭力機；按羅馬度量折算，較小的攻城機約重十至十五昆塔爾（約四百五十至六百八十公斤），較大的弩炮可達二十五至六十昆塔爾，投石常在一塔倫特至三塔倫特之間。這條技術路線後來沒有中斷：拜占庭把它放大為手拉式投石機（cheirosiphon），七世紀上半葉已在圍城中使用，機架重達十餘噸，投擲百餘公斤的石彈，射程約二百至三百米；阿拉伯語稱之為 mānjanīq，源於波斯語的稱呼。阿拉伯軍隊真正接觸這門技術，是在與拜占庭的邊疆戰爭裡，708年及717至718年兩度圍攻君士坦丁堡時，由被俘或逃亡的拜占庭工程師操作的攻城器就是這一路。第二次內戰本身並沒有留下使用投石機的記載，卡面兵器屬於同一技術家族的類比：它代表的是扭力存能、一次釋放這種可以計算破壞力的攻城邏輯。真正上陣的阿拉伯裝備是雙刃直劍與薩珊式彎刀、也門人擅用的複合反曲弓與骨製箭鏃、標槍與騎槍、圓盾與高身長盾（qaws）、鎖子甲與仿薩珊的鱗甲（jighsa）、耐力極佳的阿拉伯馬與進口敘利亞馬；攻城方面則是火油陶罐、壕溝、封鎖水源與朝覲道路的圍城術，以及從埃及經佩魯修姆與加沙通往敘利亞的駱駝隊與運載馬車。
kitsEn: The stone-thrower on the card, the onager, was a Roman siege engine, settled in its form around 250 BC and described by Vitruvius in the tenth book of De architectura: a wooden frame with an iron axle on its crossbeam, the axle ends carrying torsion skeins of rope or horsehair wound wet in opposite directions, a long throwing arm with one end hooked to the skeins and the other fitted with a sling or cup, and a windlass that hauled the arm down and let it go so as to sling a stone. The Latin word onager compares the machine to a kicking donkey, and the name for this single-armed torsion engine already appears in late antique military writings such as Vegetius of the fourth century. Converted into Roman weights, the smaller engines weighed some ten to fifteen quinariae, about four hundred and fifty to six hundred and eighty kilograms, while the heavier ballistae reached twenty-five to sixty, and the stones thrown ran from about one talent to three. The line of technique was never broken: Byzantium scaled it up into the traction trebuchet, the cheirosiphon, already used in sieges in the first half of the seventh century, its frame weighing more than ten tonnes, hurling stones of a hundred kilograms or more over two to three hundred metres; the Arabs called the machine manjaniq, a word that came through Persian. The Arab armies met the technique on their frontier with Byzantium, and the siege engines worked by captive or runaway Byzantine engineers during the Arab sieges of Constantinople in 708 and again in 717 and 718 were of this family. The Second Fitna itself leaves no record of the use of stone-throwers, so the weapon on the card stands as an analogy within the same technical family: it represents the logic of a siege that stores energy by torsion and releases it in a single blow, a destructiveness that can be calculated. The arms that actually went into battle on the Arab side were the double-edged straight sword and the Sasanian curved blade, the composite reflex bow used with skill by the Yemenis and bone-tipped arrows, javelins and lances, the round shield and the tall shield known as qaws, mail and Sasanian-style scale armour called jighsa, and the hardy Arabian horse alongside imported Syrian mounts. In siege work there were jars of burning oil, ditches, the blocking of wells and of the approaches taken by pilgrims, and the caravan road that ran from Egypt through Pelusium and Gaza into Syria, with its camels and its draught horses.
tactics: 哈里發方的戰法可以概括為「不求速決，先拆對方聯盟」：穆阿維葉不急於在敘利亞平原與遜尼系決戰，而是先用突兵切斷聯軍的補給、以重金收買首領、以赦免換取放下武器，再把支持者調離本土，分散到伊拉克、北非與呼羅珊的邊郡任職，切斷其再集結的可能；遇到不得不打的會戰，也強調以騎兵機動打散聯軍陣形，而不是正面硬撼。聯軍方則相反：依賴數量與部落榮譽，先在埃及取得稅源與徵發，再集結步兵主力與龐大騎兵部隊北進，攻城與野戰並用。682年的艾因瓦爾達之役是典型：地形是敘利亞南部的峽谷與丘陵，哈里發軍在狹窄通道裏被切斷，達哈克乘勢以多面騎兵突擊，馬爾萬與馬斯拉馬兩部潰散，那一役之後哈里發方改為固守、避免野戰。683至684年麥加之圍則完全是封鎖戰：阿卜杜拉·本·阿米爾的也門兵封住城東的希薩爾通道，用弓手封鎖朝覲者通行路線，並控制井水，飢餓與缺水先於衝鋒起作用；最後以火攻燒毀卡巴，屋頂樑木與清真寺的木柱一併燒毀。692年的馬爾季阿爾達比勒是決定性的一戰：哈里發軍人數較少，但騎兵與經驗佔優，聯軍步兵被側翼的騎兵切斷聯繫，陣形一旦崩散就無法重整，潰兵被追入荒原，聯軍首領只剩隨從相伴。事後的收編手法與戰術同樣重要：伊本·阿什阿特被帶到穆阿維葉面前受審，得到赦免與榮譽，一度表現出寬容，數月之後仍被處死，此舉給阿拉伯人記住了背叛者必受懲戒的例子，也使更多聯軍支持者選擇流亡或改投馬爾萬一方。
tacticsEn: The way the caliph's side fought can be summed up as: no hurry for a decision, and the breaking up of the other side's alliance first. Muawi did not hurry to give battle to the Qaysi on the Syrian plain; he used sudden detachments to cut the confederation's supplies, bought off leaders with heavy gold, exchanged pardon for the laying down of arms, and then moved the supporters away from their own districts, posting them to the frontiers of Iraq, North Africa and Khurasan so that they could not gather again. When a general engagement could not be avoided, the stress fell on cavalry manoeuvre to break up the confederate formations rather than on a frontal slog. The confederation worked the other way round, resting on numbers and on tribal honour: first it took the revenues and the levies of Egypt, then it massed infantry in the main body with a great mass of cavalry, advancing north and combining siege with field action. The battle of Ayn al-Warda in 682 is the type: the ground was the defiles and hills of southern Syria, the caliph's army was cut inside a narrow passage, and al-Dahhak struck with cavalry on several fronts, the two contingents of Marwan and Maslama scattering. After that defeat the caliph's side changed to a war of fixed positions and avoided open battle. The siege of Mecca in 683 and 684 was in effect a blockade: Abd Allah ibn Amir's Yemeni troops sealed the al-Hisar pass east of the town, archers covered the road by which pilgrims came, and control of the wells did the rest, hunger and thirst working before any assault; at the end fire was set to the Kaaba, and the roof beams and the wooden columns of the mosque burned with it. The decisive action came at Marj Ardabil in 692: the caliph's army was smaller but superior in cavalry and in experience, the confederate foot was cut off from the rest by a flank of horsemen, and once the formation broke it could not be re-formed; the fugitives were hunted across the uplands, and the confederate leader was left with a few companions. The method of taking men back into the fold matched the tactics: Ishaq ibn al-Ash'ath was brought before Muawi and examined, was pardoned and honoured, and was for a time treated with generosity, but was put to death some months later, an act that taught the Arabs an example of what was owed to traitors and that pushed more of the confederation's supporters into exile or over to Marwan's side.
data: 可核對的數字有三類。第一類是年表節點：第二次內戰起於680年，止於692年，前後約十二年；682年有敘利亞的艾因瓦爾達之役，683至684年有麥加被焚與希薩爾封鎖的一役，692年有約旦東北部的馬爾季阿爾達比勒之役；694至695年，北非另有一場得到拜占庭支援的遜尼系叛亂被平定，可視為內戰的餘波與下一波革命的引信。第二類是技術參數：羅馬度量一昆塔爾約四十五公斤，一塔倫特約三十公斤；羅馬攻城弩機按維特魯威斯留下的等級折算約四百五十公斤至二千七百公斤不等，投石約三十至九十公斤；拜占庭手拉式投石機的機架重約十至十五噸，投擲石彈約一百至二百公斤，射程二百至三百米，重建試驗的結果因扭力束材質、臂長與釋放角不同而分歧頗大。第三類是必須打折的推估：阿拉伯方面的兵員數字幾乎全缺，史料只說「聯軍」、「大軍」、「數十萬」這類泛稱，因此聯軍的實際作戰兵力當在數萬量級，絕大多數是各部落徵來的步兵；哈里發方以阿沙斯為骨幹的中央軍規模同樣不明，但史料一致強調其騎兵質量與將領經驗優於聯軍。地名的考訂也有分歧：馬爾季阿爾達比勒一地，或指安曼附近的馬爾季阿爾達比勒，或指大馬士革以南的馬爾賈利勒，兩說各有支持者，近代研究多採用前者。技術史方面，七世紀的阿拉伯工程記載並沒有留下這場內戰使用攻城器的可靠紀錄，這本身就是資料空白。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall into three classes. The first is the chronological nodes: the Second Fitna began in 680 and ended in 692, some twelve years in all; there was the battle of Ayn al-Warda in Syria in 682, the burning of Mecca and the blockade of al-Hisar in 683 and 684, and the battle of Marj Ardabil in the north-east of Jordan in 692; in 694 and 695 a further Qaysi rising in North Africa, backed by Byzantium, was put down, and can be read as the aftermath of the civil war and the fuse of the revolution to come. The second class is technical: the Roman quinarius was about forty-five kilograms and the Roman talent about thirty; the Roman siege engines converted from the grades Vitruvius leaves run from about four hundred and fifty kilograms to two thousand seven hundred, and threw stones of roughly thirty to ninety kilograms; the Byzantine traction trebuchet had a frame of about ten to fifteen tonnes, threw stones of a hundred to two hundred kilograms over two to three hundred metres, and the results of reconstruction trials differ widely according to the material of the skeins, the length of the arm and the angle of release. The third class is estimate and must be discounted: figures of strength for the Arab side are almost wholly missing, the sources using only the general terms confederation, great army and myriads, so the confederation's actual field strength was probably in the tens of thousands, the great majority of them foot levied from the tribes; the size of the central army built on the ashraf is equally unknown, though the sources agree that its cavalry and its generals were better than those of the confederation. The identification of place names is disputed too: Marj Ardabil is placed either near Amman in Jordan or at Marj al-Jarabil south of Damascus, each reading having its supporters, and modern studies favour the former. As for the technical history, the Arab engineering literature of the seventh century preserves no reliable record of siege engines in this civil war, and that silence is itself a fact about the sources.
cause: 起火有四層。第一層是繼承程序：680年雅齊德一世病逝，遺囑把哈里發之位傳給年幼的瓦立德，留下一個兒子眾多、各支互不相讓的局面；穆阿維葉以叔叔的身分入主大馬士革，先立幼子雅齊德二世，隨即在兩年內三次換人，這種指定的做法在阿拉伯的傳統共識裡毫無先例，等於公開宣告哈里發之位可以被廢立，遜尼系因此有充分理由聚集到維護先知血統的旗號下。第二層是部落舊怨：第一次內戰中支持阿里的主要是也門系的卡爾比部族與哈希姆家系，奪權之後哈希姆家的領袖被逐一清除，也門人淪為附庸；遜尼系自認是先知民族的支柱，主張哈里發之位應由先知家族或其親信出任，兩種部落認同在此正面撞擊。第三層是第一次內戰的未了帳：伊本·阿什阿特之父曾被雅齊德一世以羞辱性的方式調遣，這筆羞辱未經清算，哈里發方在戰略上需要有人負責，叛軍則需要有人帶頭。第四層是外力：拜占庭把這場內戰視為削弱阿拉伯人的機會，提供金錢、武器與後方避難地；南方的迦太基與北非據點雖在哈里發方手中，哈里發本人卻必須靠它們的稅收維持局面。所有這些都說明，所謂第二次內戰並非單純的權力爭奪，而是新制度在尚未定型時，被自身的繼承難題和底下的部落結構撕裂的過程。
causeEn: There were four layers to the outbreak. The first was the procedure of succession. Yazid I fell ill and died in 680, leaving a will that gave the caliphate to the child Walid and a situation in which a number of sons and branches were left contesting one another; Muawi came to power in Damascus as the uncle of the dead caliph, set up the boy Yazid II, and changed the man three times within two years. Such designation had no precedent in Arab consensus, and it announced openly that the caliphate could be made and unmade, which gave the Qaysi a full reason to gather under the banner of preserving the blood of the Prophet. The second layer was old tribal grievance: those who had supported Ali in the First Fitna were largely the Kalbi clans of the south and the house of Hashim, and after the victory the Hashimi leaders were removed one by one while the Yemenis were reduced to clients; the Qaysi, who counted themselves the props of the Prophet's community, held that the caliphate belonged to the family of the Prophet or to its intimate followers, and the two tribal identities came into open collision. The third layer was the unfinished account of the First Fitna: the father of Ishaq ibn al-Ash'ath had been moved about in a humiliating manner on the orders of Yazid I, that humiliation was never settled, the caliph's side needed someone to answer for it, and the rebels needed someone to lead. The fourth layer was outside help: Byzantium saw the civil war as a chance to weaken the Arabs and supplied money, weapons and a place of refuge behind the frontier, while Carthage and the North African bases, though on the caliph's side, had to be held so that the revenue would keep flowing, and Muawi could not afford to lose them. All of this makes it clear that the so-called Second Fitna was not a simple struggle for power, but the process by which a new institution, not yet settled in shape, was torn apart by its own difficulty over succession and by the tribal structure underneath it.
impact: 這場內戰的結果寫進了倭馬亞王朝的體質。第一，哈里發之位從先知血統的應然，變成可以授予的權柄，而授予的方式日後被馬爾萬一系的子孫遵為常例，倭馬亞王朝從此以世襲立國；第一次內戰已經處理了誰來繼承的問題，第二次內戰處理的是由誰授權的問題，兩者相加才有此後三百年的哈里發體制。第二，遜尼系被打入統治核心：此後的哈里發朝中，遜尼出身的將領與地方長官大量湧入，與卡爾比、也門系輪替分享權位，阿拉伯帝國的軍政人事自此不再是先知家族與倭馬亞家兩家的事。第三，穆斯林史上第一次出現哈里發向敵方首領許諾安全再將其殺害的案例，伊本·阿什阿特之死在阿拉伯的政治記憶裡留下一道裂痕，被後世用來指責統治者的背信，也讓日後反對倭馬亞的運動得以主張不必再向哈里發效忠。第四，麥加的焚毀與重建把卡巴的形制固定下來，重建後的卡巴改用二十根石柱、上層加高、內部加建一道走廊的樣式，直到二十世紀重建之前都是這個格局；也門人優素福主持重建，因而在阿拉伯詩歌傳統中留下焚燒者的名號與大量詩篇，戰爭文學第一次成為阿拉伯詩歌的重要門類。第五，拜占庭與阿拉伯人在南部前線的長期角力消耗了哈里發國的力量，這場內戰尤其拖累了正面，二十五年後的717至718年圍攻君士坦丁堡時，阿拉伯人才重新把工程力量投到攻城器上。
impactEn: The outcome of this civil war was written into the constitution of the Umayyad dynasty. First, the caliphate ceased to be an inheritance owed by the blood of the Prophet and became a power that could be conferred, and the manner of conferring it was afterwards followed as a custom by the descendants of the house of Marwan, so that the Umayyad state was built on hereditary succession; the First Fitna had already settled the question of who was to succeed, and the Second Fitna settled the question of who was to authorise, and the two together produced the caliphal system of the three centuries that followed. Second, the Qaysi were driven into the core of the ruling order: from that time on Umayyad commanders and provincial governors of Qaysi origin poured in, sharing office with the Kalbi and the Yemenis in turn, and the personnel of the Arab empire was no longer the business of two houses alone, the Prophet's family and the Umayyads. Third, the Muslim record saw for the first time a caliph who promised safety to a rebel leader and then killed him, and the death of Ishaq ibn al-Ash'ath left a fissure in Arab political memory, used by later generations to reproach rulers for breaking their word and to argue that no further obedience was owed to the caliph. Fourth, the burning and the rebuilding of Mecca fixed the form of the Kaaba: the rebuilt shrine, with twenty stone columns, a raised upper storey and an inner corridor, kept that shape until the twentieth century, and the rebuilding, supervised by the Yemeni Yusuf, gave the Arab poetic tradition its burner and a body of verse, and war poetry became for the first time an important genre of Arabic song. Fifth, the long struggle on the southern frontier with Byzantium drained the caliphate of strength, and it was only at the sieges of Constantinople in 717 and 718, a quarter of a century later, that the Arabs put their engineering effort once more into the siege engines.
result: 692年，馬爾季阿爾達比勒的會戰以聯軍的崩潰收場。哈里發軍的騎兵切斷聯軍步兵與騎兵的聯繫，各部落失去統一號令，陣形一散便各自奔散，追擊在約旦東北部的高原與峽谷間進行，聯軍被大量俘虜，首領伊本·阿什阿特只帶少數人逃入荒野，隨後被部下交出，送到穆阿維葉面前。哈里發當場許諾接納他，讓他保留原有的部眾與榮譽，甚至一度表現出寬容，但數月之後仍下令將其處死，屍首被棄於城外。哈里發方付出的代價並不小：麥加的卡巴被燒成廢墟，柱樑與屋頂需要重造，重建工程拖到692至693年才由也門人優素福主持完成；哈里發國內部的部落舊怨被這場清洗徹底改寫，遜尼系的怨憤並未消失，只是被壓在水面之下，此後每次哈里發更替、每次邊郡調動，都可能把它重新掀出來。整體看，第二次內戰解決了哈里發國最要緊的問題：誰能指定繼承者，聯盟如何收編，叛軍如何壓制；它沒有解決的是聯盟內部的部落矛盾，那些矛盾在半個世紀後的阿拔斯革命中以更激烈的形式重新爆發。站在裝備與技術的角度，這場戰爭留下的直接痕跡不在攻城器上，而在兵種結構上：聯軍證明人數與部落榮譽在面對組織度更高的中央騎兵時會迅速崩解，這條經驗後來在阿拉伯的軍事敘述與詩人戰史裡常被引作反面教材。
resultEn: In 692 the battle of Marj Ardabil ended with the collapse of the confederation. The cavalry of the caliph's army cut the confederate foot off from the rest, the tribes lost a common word of command, and the formation broke into separate flight; the pursuit ran across the uplands and defiles of the north-east of Jordan, many of the confederates were taken, and the leader Ishaq ibn al-Ash'ath fled into the waste with a few men and was then handed over by his own followers and brought before Muawi. The caliph promised to take him in, to let him keep his people and his honours, and for a while showed something close to generosity, but some months later he still gave the order for his death, and the body was thrown outside the walls. The caliph's side paid a price too: the Kaaba at Mecca was reduced to a ruin, its columns and roof beams had to be made afresh, and the work of rebuilding dragged on until 692 and 693 before the Yemeni Yusuf saw it through; inside the caliphate the old tribal scores were rewritten by the purge, and the resentment of the Qaysi did not disappear, it was only pushed under the surface, where every change of caliph and every transfer of provincial troops could bring it up again. As a whole, the Second Fitna settled the most urgent problems of the caliphate: who could nominate a successor, how an alliance was taken back into the fold, and how a rebellion was put down. What it did not settle was the tribal conflict inside the alliance, and that conflict broke out again half a century later in the Abbasid revolution, in a more violent form. From the point of view of equipment and technique, the war left no direct trace in the siege engines, but a deep one in the structure of the army: the confederation showed that numbers and tribal honour collapse quickly when they meet a central cavalry of better organisation, and in the military narratives and the verse chronicles of the Arabs that lesson has since been cited again and again as a warning.
